step: S3 tooltip coverage + accessibility + no-clip evidence

examples.help: Scales the whole card. 100% is standard; per-element sizes stay relative.
Master switch for every glow. Off = flat look; per-element glow settings are kept.
Lower = snappier, closer to real-time. Higher = lazier and uses less CPU.
Only works if Card opacity is below 100.

edge_clip_test.note: tooltip opens below the row; max-width capped to row width (calc(100% - 8px)) so it structurally cannot clip the sidebar's right edge

keyboard_test.note: help-icon is a real <button>, Tab-focusable; CSS :focus reveals the tooltip; Esc closes + blurs the focused icon
